She also exposed a16z leaking AWS keys, database credentials, and PII—sitting in inspect element. That hack could’ve compromised one of the biggest VCs in crypto. Her reward? $0. Then, she discovered a way to hijack someone’s Arc browser without them even visiting a website — letting attackers execute arbitrary JavaScript on any page. That time, she got $2K. $57K total for stopping multiple disasters. Some people break crypto. Xyzeva keeps saving it.
